title: Clean up obsolete little-mester logo assets (v1→v2 migration)
objective: Remove the legacy ASCII logo file and v1 config artifacts that are superseded by the v2 plugin system. After merging main into feat/ticket-context, verify whether agent/opencode/little-mester-logo.txt is still used or has been fully replaced by the tui.tsx plugin in agent/opencode/plugins/little-mester-logo/. If confirmed obsolete (no remaining references in Dockerfile, README, DECISIONS.md, or any other tracked file), delete it along with agent/opencode/tui.json and confirm all opencode config now uses OPENCODE_CLI_CONFIG_CONTENT (inlined JSON) rather than external tui.json files.

subtickets.title: Determine if little-mester-logo.txt is still referenced after merge
subtickets.objective: After M1 conflict resolution, run: grep -rl 'little-mester-logo.txt' --include='*.md' --include='*.json' --include='*.sh' --include='Dockerfile' --include='compose.yaml' across the repo. If zero matches and nothing references it in DECISIONS.md J.3 or README, mark for deletion.

subtickets.title: Remove agent/opencode/little-mester-logo.txt if confirmed obsolete
subtickets.objective: Delete the file and any related gitkeep files (e.g., agent/opencode/plugins/little-mester-logo.txt) with a commit message referencing ticket-020. Update any docs that mention it as reference.

subtickets.title: Remove agent/opencode/tui.json and update all references
subtickets.objective: Delete the v1-style tui.json file (superseded by OPENCODE_CLI_CONFIG_CONTENT). Update docs/DECISIONS.md section J.2 to confirm OPENCODE_CLI_CONFIG_CONTENT is the only mechanism. Verify no scripts or README entries reference tui.json.

subtickets.title: Cross-check all plugin directories for consistency
subtickets.objective: List every directory under agent/opencode/plugins/ and confirm each has: (1) a package.json with name matching dir name, (2) a tui.tsx or index.ts entry point, (3) corresponding COPY lines in Dockerfile if baked into image, (4) a section in DECISIONS.md J. (5) No stray .txt files or tui.json copies lingering anywhere.

notes: This ticket must be addressed after the merge completes so we can accurately determine what is still referenced. The little-mester-logo.txt legacy file currently has an add/add conflict during merge — this ticket resolves that decision. The v2 plugin system in agent/opencode/plugins/little-mester-logo/ is canonical; anything else is dead weight.

acceptance_criteria.text: Remaining references to the legacy ASCII logo and tui.json are confirmed (or found absent) in tracked files.
Obsolete logo assets and tui.json are deleted.
All opencode config uses inlined OPENCODE_CLI_CONFIG_CONTENT.
Docs/config references are updated after removal.
